objective: Add a project AGENTS.md that records the repository-specific pitfalls agents hit here, so they are not repeated, and have Claude Code load it.
scope: Work only in the git worktree /home/davidbasile/dev/holyagent-0.1.2; paths are relative to it.

Create AGENTS.md at the repository root (there is none; the project rules live in .claude/CLAUDE.md, which the maintainer asked to extend for this). Add one import line `@../AGENTS.md` (or the correct relative import, verify Claude Code's CLAUDE.md import syntax in its docs) at the end of .claude/CLAUDE.md so sessions load it; change nothing else in CLAUDE.md.

Content, repository-specific only (holyagent's general behavior belongs in the holyagent instructions, not here), each a short imperative with the reason: (1) Sessions here load the holyagent plugin from this checkout through the directory marketplace in .claude/settings.json, so checking out a branch that moves or deletes the plugin folder breaks the running session's hooks (every Bash call blocks) and its workflows: keep the main checkout on main and work on other branches in git worktrees (for example ../holyagent-<branch-slug>). (2) The Intent state in .holyagent/ is versioned; a branch that tracks older copies blocks a checkout while newer untracked copies exist, so with worktrees copy the newer state into the worktree before `holyagent vcs commit` there. (3) `holyagent vcs pr --body-file` takes only an unignored file inside the project, and vcs refuses process words in commit and PR text (for example 'Claude Code'): rephrase, or list a domain word in vcs.allowWords of .holyagent/config.json. (4) Evidence lines in a specialist report must repeat the criterion text exactly, trailing period included, or `assignment close --accept` rejects them. (5) Run gates through mise (`mise run verify`, `mise run build` after plugin source changes) because they check for the canary Bun first. (6) Never work around a blocking hook or a denied command through another tool; stop and report it. Keep it under about 60 lines, US English, follow the repository's Markdown style and formatter.
constraints: Do not commit, push, branch, check out, or touch .git or .holyagent. Do not touch /home/davidbasile/dev/holyagent or /home/davidbasile/dev/holyagent-pr1.
Only AGENTS.md and the single import line in .claude/CLAUDE.md change.
